mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: it brought the nerve routes together with the blood supply and showed how the same muscles need both.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two organ groups into named slots was clear but fairly predictable; there was little to figure out about the pairings.

surprise.text: The lymph connection lined up with the existing neck vein instead of creating a second junction. That made it clearer that these were parts of the same model.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The named slots and the open shoulder and spine channel explained where the pieces belonged.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter if it explored how the assembled systems work together. This chapter tied them together clearly, though the mostly directed fitting steps were not very challenging.
